items.question: Who is this book written for?
items.answer: Anyone who feels capable of more but isn't sure how to get there — professional, entrepreneur, student, or homemaker. The principles are universally applicable.

items.question: Is there an audiobook version?
items.answer: Yes! Narrated by the author, available on Audible and Spotify. Hearing the words in the author's own voice adds a deeply personal dimension.

items.question: How do I book a workshop?
items.answer: Click 'Book Now' on any event card. Fill in your details, choose a payment method, and you'll receive confirmation within 24 hours.

items.question: Are workshops available online?
items.answer: Yes — webinars run via Zoom and are recorded for attendees who register but cannot attend live.
